xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5369: Dashboard main thread pinned at 100%: the /clear-orphan scan re-queries SQLite for 4000 transcripts every poll tick

plan.title: Dashboard main thread pinned at 100%: the /clear-orphan scan re-queries SQLite for 4000 transcripts every poll tick
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: The 10 s conversation lifecycle poll's /clear-orphan scan (detectOrphanedClaudeCodeSessions in src/dashboard/server/services/conversation-lifecycle.ts) calls getConversationByClaudeSessionId once per transcript that is not already proven non-orphan. Owned transcripts are never skipped, the query scans every conversation row because conversation_files has no locator index, and the full conversation select sorts every locator of the matched row. On live data (4089 transcripts in one project dir, 3930 conversations) one tick spends 11.6 s of synchronous SQLite on the main thread, so slow routes such as /api/costs/summary never answer. Short transcripts (5 lines or fewer, 721 live) are also re-opened every tick, and fork adoption's backgrounding-marker scan uses the same full-select ownership check per file.
narratives.Proposal: Load every conversation locator once per tick into a Set (about 10 ms) and check transcripts against it; re-check one session with an existence-only point query just before adopting it, and add adopted ids to the Set. Memoize provisional (short-file) verdicts by size:mtimeMs so unchanged short transcripts are not re-read. Add conv_files_locator_idx on conversation_files(locator) to the init migration and the runtime top-ups, and rewrite getConversationByClaudeSessionId to drive from that index with ORDER BY c.rowid LIMIT 1 (verified to return the same row as today for all 8215 live locators). Switch fork adoption's default isLocatorOwned to the existence query. Document the behavior in docs/DASHBOARD-ARCHITECTURE.md, the codebase concerns map and changelog.d/pan-5369.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Do not cache findProjectByPath / canonicalPath / realpathSync, and do not change runPullRequestSyncOnce or loadIssueStatesForProject (tracked in PAN-5381).
- Do not change LEGACY_CONVERSATION_SELECT or its claude_session_id subquery, and do not change how sequencer-runner accumulates locators.
- Do not edit hooks.ts, vault-liveness.ts, conversation-pull.ts or conversation-reads.ts call sites.
- Do not add a per-boot memo of owned transcripts (a deleted locator row must become visible on the next tick).
- Do not memoize the no-parent-found outcome for /clear orphans without an Overdeck parent.
- Do not regenerate docs/overdeck-db-erd.excalidraw.
- Do not move the poll to a worker thread and do not change POLL_INTERVAL_MS.
- Do not add synchronous filesystem calls to server-reachable code.
- Do not grow src/lib/overdeck/conversations.ts by any line.

autoDecisions.summary: Use a per-tick Set of all locators instead of the issue's suggested per-boot memo of linked transcripts.
autoDecisions.rationale: Loading the Set costs about 10 ms per tick on live data, and a per-boot memo would go stale when vacateConversationName or removeVaultBrowseRow deletes locator rows; the Set gives today's exact answer at bulk cost.

autoDecisions.summary: Apply both fix directions: the per-tick Set for the scan, plus conv_files_locator_idx and an index-driven getConversationByClaudeSessionId.
autoDecisions.rationale: hooks.ts and fork adoption call the same lookup on every hook event and marker scan; the index fixes their misses without editing those call sites.

autoDecisions.summary: Pin getConversationByClaudeSessionId to ORDER BY c.rowid LIMIT 1.
autoDecisions.rationale: Today's SCAN c returns the lowest rowid; planning verified zero differences across all 8215 live locators with the pin, while the unpinned rewrite changed 2 of 7 shared-locator answers that hooks.ts routes on.

autoDecisions.summary: Include the short-transcript re-read memo (size:mtimeMs) in scope.
autoDecisions.rationale: It is the same per-tick repeated work in the same loop (721 live files re-opened every tick) and the stat-keyed memo is exact.

autoDecisions.summary: Leave findProjectByPath/realpathSync, runPullRequestSyncOnce and loadIssueStatesForProject to follow-up issues.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue marks them optional; findProjectByPath has about 40 callers and caching realpath needs its own invalidation design.

autoDecisions.summary: Turn the live :3011 acceptance checks into a post-deploy step in continue.json, with pre-merge proxies as item ACs.
autoDecisions.rationale: The work agent cannot run its branch as the production dashboard before merge, and pending ACs block pan done.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-2. In src/lib/overdeck/conversations.ts (function at line 617) replace the WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM conversation_files cf WHERE cf.conversation_id = c.id AND cf.locator = ?) clause with WHERE c.id IN (SELECT cf.conversation_id FROM conversation_files cf WHERE cf.locator = ?) ORDER BY c.rowid LIMIT 1, keeping the function the same number of lines (the file is above the 1000-line ceiling and must not grow). Add three tests to conversation-locator-index.test.ts: two conversations sharing locator 'shared' (second one's conversation_files row inserted raw) returns the first-created (lowest rowid) name; EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN of the SQL the function prepares has a detail containing conv_files_locator_idx and no detail equal to 'SCAN c'; an unknown locator returns null. The plan test must exercise the SQL the function itself prepares: vi.spyOn(getOverdeckDatabase(), 'prepare') (overdeckDb() returns that cached handle), call getConversationByClaudeSessionId('shared'), take the prepared SQL containing 'cf.locator = ?', restore the spy, and run EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN on that SQL. Assert a detail contains conv_files_locator_idx and no detail equals 'SCAN c'; this assertion fails on today's WHERE EXISTS query.
